I am planting maize on this 2.59 hectare plot that I rented here in the North East. The soil is not very fertile, so I will apply some bags of NPK fertilizer that I managed to get through the subsidy program, though money is tight and I cannot afford the full recommended amount. I will use my own saved maize seed because the hybrid seeds from the agro-dealer are too expensive for a rented plot, and we will do the weeding by hand since chemicals are costly. With the size of this plot, my family will put in many days, but I will also need to hire extra hands during land preparation and harvest.
